**Status: Settlement prepared for human approval**

The claims system returned "pending_approval" from stage_settlement. Nothing has been paid, and a human handler still needs to approve the payment.

**Facts recorded (claim final-CLM-10, policy VER-1003)**
- Policyholder: Ines Haddad, 2019 Toyota Yaris, market value €9,000.
- Coverage: C4 Theft, which is in the Policy Schedule.
- Incident: theft from a supermarket car park on 16 October 2026. Reported 17 October 2026 (1 day later).
- No third party involved. No repair cost (theft claim).
- Documents: police_report.pdf, counted as provided (I could not open it).

**Reasoning**
- **Coverage:** Theft is covered under C4, and the Policy Schedule lists it. The contract defines the amount of a theft claim as the market value of the vehicle. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="1-2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Timing:** A theft must be reported within 2 days of discovery. The claim was reported 1 day after the incident, so it is on time. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Exclusions:** The email gives no sign of any Article 3 exclusion (alcohol, licence, racing, intent, wear). I have not raised any doubt that the contract does not require. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="2" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>
- **Documents:** The system's required list is the police report only, and it is attached. Nothing is missing, so no document request was needed.
- **Blocking issues:** None. The claim is not referred to a handler under Article 7. <cite document_id="2630#10414" pages="3" name="DriveSafe Motor Policy"/>

**Amounts (from compute_settlement only)**
- Deductible: €900
- Payout: €8,100
- Assessor required: No

I checked the timing and coverage rules directly in the contract. I did not independently verify the deductible rule or the payout article. The subagent could not open the contract from the sandbox, and it cited the system's own outputs for those points (Art. 2 and Art. 6.2). A handler should confirm the €900 deductible against the contract before approving.

**Draft message to the customer**

> Dear Ms Haddad,
>
> Thank you for reporting the theft of your car on 16 October 2026 and for sending the police report. We have recorded your claim (reference final-CLM-10). It has now been passed to one of our claims handlers for final review, who will confirm the next steps. We will write to you again once that review is complete.
>
> Kind regards,
> Veridia Claims
